تشتروا (form VIII)
# تَشْتَرُوا (taštarū) /taʃ.ta.ruː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِشْتَرَى (ištarā)
# تُشْتَرَوْا (tuštaraw) /tuʃ.ta.raw/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِشْتَرَى (ištarā)
